name: Milwaukee 2527-21
blurb: 6″ bar, 3/8″ low profile chain, .043″ gauge, 28 drive links (Oregon R28), from Oregon's saw-chain selection guide.
intro: Oregon's saw-chain selection guide gives Milwaukee 2527-21 its own line: Oregon R28, a 6″ bar, 28 drive links, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. The guide does not print a file size. Oregon's line is 2527-21. The bar length on that line is 6″.

bars.note: Oregon prints R28 for this model line: 6″ bar, 28 drive links, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ low profile. No file size is printed.

sources.title: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide: model line printed with saw-chain code, bar length, drive links, gauge and pitch

sources_note: Oregon Saw Chain Selection Guide (https://apps.oregonproducts.com/pdfs/TSC-Chain-Fit-Guide.pdf), read 9 Nov 2026. The row restates the model line Oregon prints for this saw. Oregon does not print a file size on that line.
